primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired analysis on paired_binary_episode_v1 records. For each intent pair (baseline, guarded) compute binary_label_safe outcomes and form the 2x2 paired contingency table. Apply failed-call treatment 'complete_pair_primary' (exclude any incomplete pairs). Perform two-sided exact McNemar test; report exact p-value, absolute paired risk difference (guarded minus baseline) with 95% Wilson score CI, and paired counts used (n_pairs). Use only execution/raw_results.jsonl, verifier_log, and simulator_trace artifacts referenced in execution_manifest.
secondary_analyses: Absolute risk reduction (baseline - guarded) with 95% Wilson CIs computed from per-condition proportions.
Number-needed-to-repair (NNR = 1 / absolute risk reduction) with point estimate and CI derived from risk-difference CI.

Distributional comparisons of failure categories (syntax, routing loop, reachability loss, policy violation) between conditions using Fisher exact or chi-square tests; label all failure-category tests exploratory and apply BH-FDR per multiplicity_plan.
Exploratory subgroup paired McNemar tests by change-complexity strata (single-device vs multi-device); labeled exploratory and BH-FDR corrected.
sensitivity_analyses: Include high-similarity-flagged items (n-gram Jaccard ≥ 0.9) in confirmatory table and recompute primary estimand
Recompute primary estimand including exact-match leaked items (exploratory; report effect-size change)
uncertainty_quantification: Report exact two-sided McNemar p-values. Compute 95% Wilson score CIs for absolute risk differences and 95% Clopper–Pearson CIs for per-condition safe proportions. Report raw counts, proportions, and CI bounds; report BH-FDR-adjusted p-values for exploratory tests.
multiplicity_implementation: Single predefined primary confirmatory McNemar test with no multiplicity correction. All exploratory subgroup and failure-category hypothesis tests are labeled exploratory and corrected using Benjamini–Hochberg FDR at 0.05 as specified in the preregistration.
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered contamination_plan: exclude from primary confirmatory analysis any exact-match items (SHA256 equality) by moving them to an exploratory 'leaked' bucket and report counts and task_indices excluded. Flag high-similarity items (n-gram Jaccard ≥ 0.9) and include them only in sensitivity analyses. Record all contamination-detection hashes and flags from task_manifest_path; report residual uncertainty per preregistration.
table_specifications: Table 1: Paired 2x2 contingency table (baseline_safe vs baseline_unsafe) × (guarded_safe vs guarded_unsafe), n_pairs used, McNemar exact p-value, absolute risk difference (guarded - baseline) with 95% Wilson CI.
Table 2: Per-condition counts and proportions of binary_label_safe (baseline and guarded) with 95% Clopper–Pearson CIs and raw counts (numerator/denominator).
Table 3: Failure-category counts and percentages by condition (syntax, routing loop, reachability loss, policy violation) with exploratory Fisher/chi-square p-values and BH-FDR adjusted p-values.
Table 4: Contamination summary: counts of exact-match excluded items, list of excluded task_indices (leaked bucket), and count of high-similarity-flagged items included in sensitivity analyses.
figure_specifications: Figure 1: Bar chart of safe-executable proportion per condition (baseline vs guarded) with 95% Wilson CIs, computed from binary_label_safe in paired_binary_episode_v1.
Figure 2: Stacked bar chart of failure-category distribution by condition (percentages) derived from verifier_log classifications.

Figure 3: Transition/Sankey summarizing per-intent transitions (baseline_safe→guarded_safe, baseline_unsafe→guarded_safe, baseline_unsafe→guarded_unsafe, baseline_safe→guarded_unsafe) with counts from paired records.
